output.summary: Added 18 tests for GLOSS.area-of-effect to tests/srd/test_glossary.py. 16 pass and 2 are red (xfail strict). Clauses #1–#4 are covered with Sleep (Sphere at a point), Burning Hands (Cone from the caster) and Thunderwave (Cube from the caster). #1/#2: the blocked-lines check uses each shape's own point of origin: the chosen point for a Sphere, the caster for a Cone or Cube, never the aim point and never the caster for a placed Sphere. #3: a creature cut off by Total Cover rolls no save, takes nothing, isn't pushed and is logged with p.177. This also works through Session.execute and when the creature is named. #4: Half and Three-Quarters Cover don't block, and neither do creatures in the line (R-09). Total Cover does. Red findings: (1) Burning Hands sets fire to a flammable object behind Total Cover, because `_area_objects` never checks blocked lines; (2) the exclusion log event has no clause number. Clause #5 (unseen point behind a wall) can't be tested: the engine has no obstruction geometry and no visibility of points. Added four cheats to the abuse catalogue. Stage B found no scenario that needs a change.

interactions.with: GLOSS.cover / PLAY.combat.cover (Total vs Three-Quarters vs Half)
interactions.note: Only Total Cover blocks a line. Covered by Half, Three-Quarters (boundary) and Total tests.

interactions.with: R-09 (creatures give at most Half Cover)
interactions.note: A creature, or a column of them, never blocks an area. Tested with a Cube and a Cone.

interactions.with: R-10 (Total Cover doesn't refuse an area spell)
interactions.note: The spell is cast and the slot spent. The walled-off creature is just left out.

interactions.with: R-16 / SPELL.casting-spells.effects.targets#4 (the engine works out the area)
interactions.note: Naming a walled-off creature mustn't add it to the area. Tested.
Objects are placed in the area without the blocked-lines check. Red test.

interactions.with: GLOSS.sphere / SPELL.sleep (origin at the chosen point)
interactions.note: Cover is judged from the Sphere's origin, not from the caster or another point.

interactions.with: GLOSS.cone / GLOSS.cube (origin at the caster for Self-range spells)
interactions.note: The aim point only sets the direction. Cover from it is ignored, and cover from the caster counts.
A creature cut off from the origin isn't pushed either.
Stage-A gap (where blocking lines start for an Emanation). No in-scope Emanation spell, so not tested.
The engine has no wall geometry and no visibility of points: not testable.

abuse.case: Naming a creature that is walled off from the point of origin so the caller's list puts it in the area
abuse.reason: #3: a location with every line blocked isn't in the area, named or not

abuse.case: Claiming cover from the caster against a Sphere placed elsewhere
abuse.reason: #1: the energy erupts at the point of origin

abuse.case: Using a column of creatures as a wall against an area
abuse.reason: #4 + R-09: creatures never give Total Cover

abuse.case: Using a Three-Quarters obstruction (an arrow slit) to keep an area out
abuse.reason: #4: only Total Cover blocks a line

abuse.case: Placing an area at an unseen point behind a wall so it erupts on the far side
abuse.reason: #5 needs wall geometry and visibility of points, which the engine lacks (see not_testable)

abuse.case: Leaving creatures in the area off the list (existing catalogue entry)
abuse.reason: G1 isn't named and is still hit through G0

not_testable.reason: The scene has no obstruction geometry: cover is per-target labels and no_los is creature pairs. Nothing records whether the creator can see a point. So the engine can't express 'an unseen point with a wall between the creator and it', and can't move the origin to the near side.
not_testable.infra_ticket: Walls/obstructions placed between points in the scene, plus visibility of a point from a creature, so that an area placed at an unseen point behind an obstruction gets its point of origin on the near side (GLOSS.area-of-effect#5)

kind_waivers.reason: No threshold: a point of origin is a single location, with no quantity to sit one step past.
No threshold: it delegates origin placement to the shape units, whose own boundary tests (cone/cube/sphere) cover distances.
The engine's only way to express blocked lines is a cover-degree label. The degree threshold (Three-Quarters vs Total) is the boundary, and it is tested under #4.

rulings_proposed.ambiguity: GLOSS.area-of-effect ambiguity 2: 'To block a line, an obstruction must provide Total Cover': judged per location (cut off only when a target there has Total Cover from the origin) or per line (any line through a solid part is blocked)?
rulings_proposed.ruling: Per location: a location is cut off from the area exactly when a creature or object there has Total Cover from the point of origin. A Three-Quarters obstruction such as an arrow slit never cuts anything off. With R-09, creatures never block an area.
